title: Geodetic quantities

source.citation: Spada, G. et al. (2011). Geophysical Journal International 185(1), 106-132.

what_to_compute: Compute vertical displacement U, horizontal displacement V and geoid displacement N at the Earth's surface, as functions of colatitude, for a surface load applied as a Heaviside step.

reference_data.$comment: Contributor abbreviations are those of the paper's table 1. For a converted test, the files read and what each column holds are in the `files` table of gia_mip/resources/spada_column_layouts.json. `not_converted` gives, per contributor, the reason its data is not in the converted file.

not_converted.BL: No file in the archive is attributable to BL for this test: the published script draws GS's TABOO files and VK's VILMA files only (correction spada-t02-01-contributors-without-data). Figure 12a of the paper draws BL's U for the cap from 0 to 15 degrees; no file holds it.
not_converted.PG: No file in the archive is attributable to PG for this test: the published script draws GS's TABOO files and VK's VILMA files only (correction spada-t02-01-contributors-without-data). Figure 12a of the paper draws PG's U for the cap from 0 to 15 degrees; no file holds it.
not_converted.ZM: No file in the archive is attributable to ZM for this test: the published script draws GS's TABOO files and VK's VILMA files only (correction spada-t02-01-contributors-without-data). Tables 10 to 12 of the paper print ZM's U, V and N for the cap at 8 colatitudes and 4 times; no file holds them.

reference_data.reference_status: closed on 2026-09-15 by Sia Ghelichkhani: the archive spada2011-cost-es0701 is the reference data for this test, and what it lacks is recorded in not_converted and status. New data for a gap is added as a new original, with its own provenance and corrections.

status: converted: GS (cap, disc and point load) and VK (cap and disc) in data/converted/spada2011/spada2011-t02-01.nc. BL, PG and ZM supplied no data in the archive.
